summary.text: Diane Papan was first elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 and reelected in 2024. She represents the 21st Assembly District, which includes the Bayside of San Mateo County from Brisbane to East Palo Alto.

paragraphs.text: Before the Assembly she served as mayor and city councilmember of San Mateo.
Papan is a native of San Mateo County, raised in Daly City and Millbrae. She earned a B.A. in political science from UCLA in 1985 and a J.D. from UC Hastings College of the Law in 1988.
She has worked as an attorney, including in her own private practice, and is executive director of the nonprofit John's Closet in Daly City.
